name: io.github.dkships/pm-copilot
description: Triangulates support tickets, feature requests, and AI agent chats to prioritize product work

environmentVariables.description: Optional ProductLift portals as comma-separated name|url|api_key entries

environmentVariables.description: Optional Chatbase agents as comma-separated name|agent_id entries, one per product
environmentVariables.name: CHATBASE_AGENTS
